title: Modified diff rows can render blank when spans are absent

evidence.quote:
const oldText = change.oldBlock ? blockText(change.oldBlock) : null;
  const newText = change.newBlock ? blockText(change.newBlock) : null;

function renderSpans(spans: WordSpan[] | undefined, side: 'old' | 'new') {
  if (!spans) return null;

reasoning: DiffRowView computes oldText and newText for every change, but the modified case ignores them and renders only renderSpans(change.spans). renderSpans explicitly returns null when spans are undefined, so a modified change with oldBlock/newBlock but no spans produces empty old and new cells instead of falling back to paragraph text.
reproduction: Render DiffView with a text diff containing a modified Change that has oldBlock and newBlock but no spans. The modified row cells are empty.
recommendation: Mirror the slide-row fallback pattern: when change.spans is absent, render oldText and newText for modified rows; only use renderSpans when spans are present.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise DiffView rendering, and the package test script does not run assertions.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a DiffView render test for a modified text change without spans and assert both old and new block text are visible.
minimumFixScope: Change the modified case in DiffRowView and add a focused render regression test.
